edits.current: Pensioner whose pension is paid by a fund, not by the employer
edits.proposed: Pensioner: pension paid by a fund, or paid directly by the employer

edits.current: The paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer.
edits.proposed: Paid by a fund: NO - the paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer. Paid directly by the employer (pensioner 'a cargo del empleador'): YES - the document supports the payments 'que se desprenden de una relación laboral o legal y reglamentaria y los pensionados a cargo del empleador', the employer that makes payments 'a los pensionados a cargo del empleador' is obliged to issue it, and the pensioner is a beneficiary of the payment (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 arts. 1.5.3.2.1, 1.5.3.2.3 and 1.5.3.1.1 num. 5).

edits.current: Annex table 5.5.4 recognises only TWO values: 00 No Aplica and 01 Dependiente old-age pensioner activo. This is much narrower than the twelve-value PILA subtipo list; an employed old-age pensioner is 01, everyone else is 00.
edits.proposed: Annex table 5.5.4 recognises only TWO values: 00 No Aplica and 01 Dependiente pensionado por vejez activo. This is much narrower than the twelve-value PILA subtipo list; an employed old-age pensioner is 01, every other employee is 00.
